statement: Require agents to account for intent before finishing changes, bind reviews to the actual changed content, and expose unmet requirements without rewriting intent to match implementation.

source.reference: 2026-09-27 Specify conversation: user approval of capture, retrieval, focused specs, and completion reconciliation proposal.

rationale: Approved proposal requires changed, preserved, and unmet intent to be visible. Deterministic checks establish recorded process; semantic fidelity and test execution need separate review and evidence.
